summary: Added the permanent orchestrator queue route on control/codex-main. It permits only atomic TASKS, LOG, STATE, and optional OWNERS ledger updates; rejects stale bases, transient forbidden history, invalid candidate context pins, and expired candidate leases; and preserves mandatory handoffs and acceptance for ordinary implementation lanes.

pre_change_proof.evidence: The changed queue-lifecycle governance tests were applied to the trusted pre-change implementation and failed before the permanent orchestrator route existed.

post_change_proof.evidence: Exact tested code SHA 36ae95a passed the complete governance suite; the focused queue lifecycle regression passed 7 of 7 cases under independent adversarial review.
The checked-in board passed schema, lease, dependency, ownership, command-shape, and acceptance validation.
Git diff hygiene passed for integration base 309a564 through exact tested code 36ae95a.

adversarial_review.goal: Find fail-open routes in permanent queue scope, introduced history, stale-base handling, candidate context validation, lease recovery, prior-handoff drift classification, ordinary-lane handoffs, acceptance, or weakened checks.

open_risks.description: The current private-repository plan cannot enforce required checks or CODEOWNERS; codex-main remains the sole merger.
Shared GitHub credentials make agent and reviewer identifiers routing labels rather than cryptographic identities.
The current product base exceeds the target two-failure ceiling; CTRL-001 is control-only and does not claim to repair product tests.
The local full product suite remains resource-refused; focused governance checks are complete and product regression is classified separately.
